description.value: Fresh St. Market is a BC-based grocery chain positioning itself around fresh, local, and Canadian products. The Kitsilano branch sits on West 4th Avenue, a major cycling corridor connecting downtown Vancouver to UBC, making it a natural resupply stop for touring cyclists passing through the neighbourhood. The store carries a broad range of departments from a full deli and prepared foods counter to produce, seafood, bakery, and household goods.

Basic groceries are unambiguously confirmed. No bike-specific amenities (parking, pump, charging, washrooms) are mentioned anywhere in the website content or OSM tags, so those remain null. One minor discrepancy: the website's pickup-reservation header defaults to 'FRESH ST. MARKET VANCOUVER HOUSE' rather than the Kitsilano branch, likely a session/store-selector artifact rather than a record mismatch.
